title: Fourier Residual Networks Achieve Spectral Accuracy for Discontinuous Functions
summary: We present a constructive approximation framework for analyzing the expressive power of Fourier residual networks in approximating a broad class of one-dimensional functions. Our study covers both piecewise continuous functions -- including those with jump discontinuities in the function and its derivatives -- and fully smooth functions.
